results.question: What are the conditions for urgent orders and how do they relate to the Delivery SLA?
results.answer: Urgent orders are placed when a spare part is required to prevent significant vessel downtime or an operational interruption. They are subject to the conditions outlined in Section 6 of the Supplier Terms & Conditions, which are also applicable to urgent deliveries. These conditions include the need for urgent requests to identify the vessel or project, delivery location, required arrival date, and operational justification. The urgent delivery surcharges, which vary by supplier, must be quoted and approved in writing before dispatch. The Delivery SLA covers order processing, dispatch, regional delivery windows, shipment tracking, delay notification, and service penalties. It also includes provisions for late delivery penalties and urgent delivery services.
